effect_description_eng:
＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it was played.)
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] To all of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP for the turn for each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Place 1 of your opponent's Digimon as the top security card. Then, if this Digimon has 4 or more colors in its digivolution cards, trash their top security card and ＜Recovery +1＞ (Place the top card of your deck as your top security card.)
